column3: The coordinator chat stays mounted (hidden) while a thread, file or run is open, and state/context.ts keeps the last conv.context report per conversation, re-read only when a turn ends or the popover opens; web runs bun test on state modules as prebuild, so the CI web job covers it
column4: switching back to the coordinator tab remounted the chat and its context ring re-sent conv.context (XIN-23 review on xin#12)
column6: a tab switch sends no conv.context; one per conversation per session plus one per finished turn or popover open
